_fallback.name: CPGRAMS — Central Public Grievance Redress System
_fallback.description: National grievance portal — use as a last resort if the local/state portal does not respond.
steps: Go to pgportal.gov.in and click 'Lodge Public Grievance'
Register or log in with your mobile number and email
Select the relevant Ministry/Department (e.g. Urban Development, Road Transport)
Fill the grievance form with your exact location and a clear title
Paste the petition text in the grievance description and attach your photo if you have one
Submit and save the unique Registration Number to track status

_nhai.name: NHAI — National Highways Authority of India (Rajmarg Yatra / 1033)
_nhai.description: Use ONLY if the problem is on a National Highway (NH-xx). For city/village roads use the local body instead.
steps: Confirm the road is a National Highway (look for an 'NH-<number>' milestone/board)
Call the NHAI toll-free helpline 1033 to report road/pothole/safety issues
Or download the 'Rajmarg Yatra' app and raise a complaint with location + photo
Note the highway number and the nearest chainage/km marker in your description
Paste the petition text and submit; keep the complaint reference number

_bdo.name: Block Development Officer (BDO) — Rural / Panchayat route
_bdo.description: For villages and rural/panchayat areas, the BDO is the first point of contact for civic works.
steps: Visit your Block Development Office (BDO/BDPO) in person or call the block office
Submit a written application addressed to the Block Development Officer
Quote your village, panchayat and block name clearly
Attach the petition text and a photo of the problem if available
Ask for a receiving/diary number and a date for site inspection

_collector.name: Office of the District Collector / Deputy Commissioner
_collector.description: Escalation route for rural areas or when the block/municipal office does not act.
steps: Locate your District Collector/Deputy Commissioner office website or public grievance cell
Submit a written grievance addressed to the Collector/DC
Mention your tehsil, block/village and the exact issue
Attach the petition text and supporting photo
Obtain an acknowledgement number for follow-up

_state_portal.name: Punjab Government Grievance Portal (PGRS)
_state_portal.description: State-level grievance portal for towns and areas not covered by a Municipal Corporation.
steps: Visit pgrs.punjab.gov.in and register with your mobile number
Choose the relevant department (Local Government / PWD / Water Supply)
Enter your district, town and locality
Paste the petition text and attach a photo if available
Submit and note the grievance ID

water_supply.name: PWSSB — Punjab Water Supply & Sewerage Board
water_supply.description: Use for drinking-water supply problems (no water, low pressure, contamination) in Punjab towns.
steps: Visit pwssb.punjab.gov.in/complaint-form
Select your district and subdivision
Enter your address and contact number
Describe the water-supply issue and attach the photo
Paste the petition text in the remarks field
Submit and save the complaint registration number

broken_road.name: Punjab PWD — Public Works Department
broken_road.description: Use for damaged roads, potholes and broken berms on Punjab state/district roads.
steps: Visit punjabpwd.gov.in/grievance
Select your district from the dropdown
Choose 'Roads' as the work category and pin the road segment
Attach the complaint photo as evidence
Paste the petition text in the description
Submit and note the grievance number

streetlight.name: PSPCL — Punjab State Power Corporation
streetlight.description: Use for non-functional or damaged streetlights and pole/wire hazards in Punjab.
steps: Call the PSPCL helpline 1912 for immediate reporting
Or visit pspcl.in/consumer-grievance
Select your subdivision and SDO office
Mention the pole/street and attach the photo
Paste the petition text and submit

sewage.name: PWSSB Sewerage Wing
sewage.description: Use for sewage overflow, blocked manholes and drain backflow in Punjab towns.
steps: Visit pwssb.punjab.gov.in/complaint-form
Select 'Sewerage' as the complaint category
Enter your district and locality details
Attach the photo and paste the petition text
Submit and note the complaint ID

waterlogging.name: Punjab PWD (Drainage) / Municipal Corporation
waterlogging.description: Use for waterlogging and flooding after rain in Punjab streets and underpasses.
steps: For city areas, contact the Municipal Corporation drainage department
For areas outside city limits, visit pgrs.punjab.gov.in
Select 'Public Works' / 'Drainage' as the department
Attach the photo showing the waterlogging
Paste the petition text and submit

garbage.name: Municipal Corporation / Punjab Pollution Control Board
garbage.description: Use for uncollected garbage, illegal dumping and overflowing bins in Punjab.
steps: For city garbage, contact your local Municipal Corporation sanitation wing
Visit pgrs.punjab.gov.in for online submission
Select 'Local Government' > 'Sanitation'
Attach the photo and submit with the petition text

_state_portal.name: Jansunwai — UP Integrated Grievance Redressal System
_state_portal.description: Single-window state grievance portal for all UP departments.
steps: Visit jansunwai.up.nic.in and register with OTP
Click 'Submit Grievance' and pick the right department
Enter district, tehsil and locality
Paste the petition text and attach a photo if available
Submit and note the grievance number

broken_road.name: Jansunwai UP — Roads & Highways (PWD)
broken_road.description: Use for damaged roads and potholes on UP state and district roads.
steps: Visit jansunwai.up.nic.in
Register with your mobile number (OTP verification)
Click 'Submit Grievance' and select 'Public Works Department'
Fill your location details and complaint description
Attach the complaint photo if available
Paste the petition text and submit; note the registration number

water_supply.name: Jal Jeevan Mission UP / Jansunwai
water_supply.description: Use for drinking-water supply failures in UP.
steps: Visit jansunwai.up.nic.in
Register and select 'Jal Nigam' as the department
Enter your locality and describe the supply issue
Submit with photo and petition text

streetlight.name: UPPCL — UP Power Corporation
streetlight.description: Use for streetlight and power-line faults in UP.
steps: Call 1912 for immediate reporting
Or visit uppclonline.com/grievance
Select your division and substation
Submit with the photo and petition text

sewage.name: Jansunwai UP — Jal Nigam (Sewerage)
sewage.description: Use for sewage overflow and blocked drains in UP towns.
steps: Visit jansunwai.up.nic.in
Select Jal Nigam > Sewerage division
Enter locality and describe the overflow
Submit with photo and petition text

waterlogging.name: Jansunwai UP — Drainage
waterlogging.description: Use for rain waterlogging and flooding in UP localities.
steps: Visit jansunwai.up.nic.in
Select PWD > Drainage
Pin the waterlogged stretch and attach a photo
Submit with petition text

garbage.name: Jansunwai UP — Nagar Nigam Sanitation
garbage.officer: Nagar Palika / Nagar Nigam Sanitation Officer
garbage.description: Use for uncollected garbage and dumping in UP urban areas.
steps: Visit jansunwai.up.nic.in
Select Urban Development > Sanitation
Enter ward and locality
Submit with photo and petition text

_state_portal.name: Delhi PGMS — Public Grievance Monitoring System
_state_portal.description: Delhi's central grievance portal across all GNCTD departments.
steps: Visit pgms.delhi.gov.in and create an account
Select the relevant department
Enter your locality and describe the issue
Paste the petition text and attach a photo
Submit and note the grievance ID

broken_road.name: Delhi PGMS / PWD Delhi
broken_road.description: Use for potholes and damaged roads maintained by PWD Delhi.
steps: Visit pgms.delhi.gov.in
Create an account and select PWD as the department
Pin the road and attach the photo
Submit with the petition text

water_supply.name: Delhi Jal Board
water_supply.description: Use for water supply and tanker issues in Delhi.
steps: Call 1916 for immediate complaint
Or visit delhijalboard.in/grievance
Enter your colony and describe the issue
Submit with photo and petition text

streetlight.name: BSES / TPDDL Grievance (via Delhi PGMS)
streetlight.description: Use for dark streets and faulty streetlights in Delhi.
steps: Call 19123 (BSES) for power/streetlight issues
Or visit pgms.delhi.gov.in > Electricity Department
Mention the street/pole and submit with a photo

sewage.name: Delhi Jal Board (Sewerage)
sewage.description: Use for sewer overflow and blocked manholes in Delhi.
steps: Call 1916 or visit delhijalboard.in/grievance
Select the Sewerage category
Enter locality and submit with photo and petition

waterlogging.name: Delhi PGMS / PWD Drainage
waterlogging.description: Use for monsoon waterlogging on Delhi roads and underpasses.
steps: Visit pgms.delhi.gov.in
Select PWD > Drainage
Pin the waterlogged spot and attach a photo
Submit with petition text

garbage.name: MCD Grievance Portal
garbage.description: Use for garbage, dead-animal removal and dumping in MCD areas.
steps: Call 1533 for immediate complaint
Or visit mcdonline.nic.in/portal/grievance
Enter ward and locality
Submit with photo and petition

_state_portal.name: Maharashtra Aaple Sarkar
_state_portal.description: State grievance portal for towns and areas outside major municipal corporations.
steps: Visit aaplesarkar.mahaonline.gov.in and log in with Aadhaar/mobile
Select the relevant department
Enter district and locality
Submit with photo and petition text

broken_road.name: Maharashtra PWD Grievance
broken_road.description: Use for damaged state/district roads in Maharashtra.
steps: Visit aaplesarkar.mahaonline.gov.in
Log in with Aadhaar or mobile
Select PWD as the department and pin the road
Submit with photo and petition text

water_supply.name: Maharashtra Jeevan Pradhikaran (MJP)
water_supply.description: Use for drinking-water supply problems in Maharashtra.
steps: Visit aaplesarkar.mahaonline.gov.in
Select the Water Supply department
Enter locality and submit with photo and petition

garbage.name: BMC / Municipal Corporation Grievance
garbage.description: Use for garbage and sanitation issues in Maharashtra cities.
steps: Visit aaplesarkar.mahaonline.gov.in
Select the Urban Local Body
Enter ward and submit the sanitation complaint with a photo

_state_portal.name: Karnataka Janasevaka / iGRS
_state_portal.description: State grievance portal for Karnataka departments.
steps: Visit janasevaka.karnataka.gov.in and register
Select the relevant department
Enter district and locality
Submit with photo and petition text

broken_road.name: Karnataka PWD Grievance
broken_road.description: Use for damaged roads on Karnataka state/district roads.
steps: Visit janasevaka.karnataka.gov.in
Register and select PWD
Pin the road and submit the complaint with a photo

water_supply.name: BWSSB / KUWSDB
water_supply.description: Use for drinking-water supply issues in Bengaluru / Karnataka.
steps: Visit bwssb.karnataka.gov.in or call 1916
Enter your area and describe the issue
Submit with photo and petition text
